info.title: Case Resolution Summary Push
info.description: Reads case detail and pushes resolution summaries via production n8n webhook.

post.description: Saves a resolution summary using the Salesforce case number.

caseNumber.description: The human-readable Salesforce CaseNumber (e.g. "00786393"), the same number used in readCaseDetail.

summary.description: Only the four-section resolution block: Query, How It Was Resolved, Additional Considerations, and How to Prevent it from happening again.
summary.example:
**Query:**
The customer could not complete the requested workflow.

**How It Was Resolved:**
The configuration was corrected and the workflow was successfully retested.

**Additional Considerations:**
The account had an incorrect system configuration that caused the failure.

**How to Prevent it from happening again:**
Validate the required configuration before enabling the workflow.

200.description: The case resolution summary was saved successfully.

400.description: The request is missing a valid caseNumber or summary.

500.description: The server could not save the case resolution summary.

get.summary: Read full case detail by case number
get.description: Returns the live Salesforce case plus its EmailMessages, FeedItems, and Tasks for the given case number. Replaces the built-in Salesforce connector, since Actions and connector Apps cannot both be enabled on the same GPT.

parameters.name: caseNumber
parameters.description: The human-readable Salesforce CaseNumber (e.g. "00786393"), not the record Id.

200.description: Case found; returns the case record plus its email messages, feed items, and tasks.

case.description: The live Salesforce Case record (all standard + custom fields returned by the case lookup).

emailMessages.description: EmailMessage records for this case, ordered oldest to newest. This is the case feed.

feedItems.description: Chatter FeedItem records for this case, ordered oldest to newest.

tasks.description: Task records related to this case, ordered oldest to newest.

400.description: The caseNumber query parameter is missing.

404.description: The case does not exist or is inaccessible.
